patterns: do not wait for the driver to assign an id
pass is not a successor trigger
stage pass does not imply successor

semantic_review_requirements: For foundation-facing tasks, enforce foundational_logic.json before freezing native premises or importing successful effective/classical definitions.
When engineering success is used, separate effective definitions withheld from native premises from engineering-success constraints consumed as evidence.
Target-side definitions copied into native premises invalidate the claimed foundational derivation unless separately declared or derived at the correct semantic strength.
A raw free-research axiom candidate is not dispatchable; taskbook creation requires the candidate lifecycle to have reached Driver intake when the task originates from free discovery.
If origin_kind=FREE_AXIOM_CANDIDATE, preserve the audited candidate id/state. Repackaging the same origin as DRIVER_ROADMAP is provenance laundering and fails review.
For task_lineage=CONTINUATION, audit the successor gate rather than accepting parent PASS, stage numbering, momentum or recent success as the reason for another stage.
Any obvious Stage 2+ task is CONTINUATION. More generally, renaming the next unresolved layer of the same parent route does not reset semantic lineage.
Continuation review must record whether closure, another owner/route or independent/free exploration was considered; no numeric exploration quota is imposed.
Every new or re-dispatched taskbook must expose execution_state_policy=INHERIT_GLOBAL and a machine-readable execution_gates list; use [] only when no task-local execution gate exists.
Any PRE_MATH gate must block both mathematical source reads and mathematical derivation until durable required evidence exists and the execution reaches EXECUTION_READY.

If task-local wording requires a checkpoint, checker, audit or publication step before selecting/freezing the primary or final verdict, encode it as a gate whose must_precede includes VERDICT_FREEZE; guarding only RETURN_WRITE is too late.
If task-local wording requires final materialization/checker/manifest evidence before the return is persisted, encode it as a PRE_RETURN gate whose must_precede includes RETURN_WRITE.

A startup publication/liveness gate may intentionally require one narrow remote branch/file write/verification. Such task-local remote behavior must be represented both as an execution gate and, when it matches TB-REMOTE-RUNTIME, as a narrow temporary override; the override does not waive the gate.
Working Truth is a task-execution discipline and must not be retroactively applied to Phase-A discovery or Phase-B prior-art/dedup audit.

Ordinary task execution inherits tool_invocation_policy.json: after task semantics are understood and before inventing new general-purpose machinery, current tool/method coverage must be checked and adequate existing tools must be reused/composed/extended rather than reimplemented under a new route name.

A taskbook with an explicit blind-forward/source-whitelist discovery firewall may delay current toolbox/method visibility only until its named raw candidate/no-go freeze point; the same task must run current-tool dedup after that freeze before claiming method novelty or opening a tool continuation.
FREE Phase A follows the same discovery-firewall timing principle: no current toolbox prior before freeze; mandatory current-tool dedup in Phase B after freeze.
Taskbooks that inherit final-response identity behavior are version-coupled to final_response_identity_policy.json; any change to that policy invalidates prior policy-review digests for redispatch.

Taskbooks that inherit execution-state behavior are version-coupled to research_execution_state_machine.json and docs/RESEARCH_EXECUTION_STATE_MACHINE.md; changes invalidate prior policy-review digests for redispatch.
